# Community Pages – all current listings

> Free, donation and £5-or-less activities across Greater Manchester. 1199 listings, updated 11 November 2026. Source: https://communitypages.org.uk/ – please check with the organiser before going.

## Regular groups, by area

### Altrincham & Hale

Chatter & Natter table every Thursday. Contact Mandy: 07868 143004. https://thechattycafescheme.co.uk/venue/mabels-cafe-tea-rooms/
- Morning Readers' Group at Altrincham Library: 1st Tuesday of the month, 10:00–11:00; Altrincham Library, 2 Pott Street, Altrincham WA14 1AH; Free. Run by Trafford Libraries. Monthly book group (6 Oct, 3 Nov, 1 Dec); to join email libraries@trafford.gov.uk. https://www.trafford.gov.uk/events/altrincham-library-readers-group
- Rhymetime at Altrincham Library: Every Thursday, 10:15–10:45; Altrincham Library, 2 Pott Street, Altrincham WA14 1AH; Free. Run by Trafford Libraries. Two sessions (10:15 and 11:15); tickets available 15 minutes before, first come first served. https://www.trafford.gov.uk/events/rhymetime-altrincham-library
